definitions.explanation: The most common verb for eating. Used for consuming food by putting it in the mouth and swallowing. This is the neutral form without politeness implications, unlike {召|め}し{上|あ}がる (meshiagaru) which is honorific or いただく (itadaku) which is humble.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}ごはんを{食|た}べましたか。
このレストランで{食|た}べよう。

notes: This is the plain/dictionary form. In polite speech, use {食|た}べます. The te-form {食|た}べて is commonly used in compound structures like {食|た}べている (eating/have eaten) and {食|た}べてみる (try eating). As an ichidan (る-verb), conjugation is straightforward: drop る and add the appropriate ending.
